thread:
maria: quick design question — in the regression-diff view for prompt sets, are we ok with the current lane visual weight? attaching a quick Figma shot: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx (see lanes on the left).

sam: feels heavy to me — lane borders pull attention away from the actual diff highlights. can we soften them to a 1px neutral and bump inner padding so highlights breathe? :thinking:

devin: also +1 for softer border. would love a density toggle (Dense / Comfortable) so power users can pick compact lanes.

alex: accessibility flag: the green "Accepted" badge fails 4.5:1 contrast on the card background. either darker green (#1E9D58) or pair with a check icon + text.

jordan: copy nit on bulk CTA — prefer "Approve selected" over "Approve batch". more explicit. also show an undo toast with countdown, e.g. "Approved — Undo (5s)" :leftwards_arrow_with_hook:

maria: fwiw the fade-out animation on diff highlights looks slick, but for 1-line diffs it disappears too fast and users miss it. idea: keep highlight until focus leaves the lane.

sam: keyboard focus currently looks identical to lane hover. that confuses keyboard users navigating many prompt-sets. propose distinct focus ring: 3px outline with accessible color and increased z-index.

alex: aria suggestions: each lane should have aria-labelledby referencing the prompt-set title. the approve checkbox needs role="switch"? maybe keep checkbox but ensure space toggles it. set aria-live="polite" on the header approval-count so screenreaders get updates.

devin: telemetry idea: track density toggle, approver clicks, and undo usage. small metric: "approve_undo_rate" to catch accidental mass approvals.

sam: quick CSS POC:
```css
.prompt-lane { border: 1px solid #E6E9EE; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFF; }
.prompt-lane:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(26,115,232,0.16); outline-offset: 2px; }
```

jordan: microcopy for empty regression state: prefer "No regressions found" vs "0 regressions" — softer and more human.

maria: thanks — I'll update the Figma with softened borders, density toggle mock, and the new CTA copy. will also add the a11y checklist (contrast + aria labels) to the ticket. planning to open a small PR with screenshots in ~2 hrs. :rocket:

aria-bot: note: a11y ticket A11Y-412 created and assigned to @alex.

alex: happy to take the a11y ticket. will run color contrast checks and keyboard walkthrough.

maria: awesome. if anyone wants to pair on the prototype before I PR, ping me. otherwise I'll post the Figma updates here when ready. :thumbsup:
